description.it: I migliori giovani di tutto il database, o di una nazione o lega. Età e soglie si possono cambiare.
description.en: The best young players in the whole database, or in one nation or league. Ages and thresholds can be changed.

widgets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age AND ability_current >= :min_ca AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league))

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age_2 AND ability_current >= :min_ca_2 AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league))

SELECT name || ' (' || ability_current || ')' AS value FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 1

title.it: Under {max_age} con abilità attuale ≥ {min_ca_2}, per età
title.en: Under-{max_age}s with current ability ≥ {min_ca_2}, by age

widgets.sql: SELECT age, count(*) AS players FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age AND ability_current >= :min_ca_2 AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) GROUP BY age ORDER BY age

widgets.label: name
widgets.sql: SELECT name, age, ability_current FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT name, age, club_name, natural_positions AS positions, ability_current, ability_potential, transfer_value FROM players WHERE age <= :max_age AND ability_current >= :min_ca AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT :top
